name: elfa metered events response (synthetic)
description: Synthetic v3/events body for the billing-header tests: three events, so the derived card is 1 + 3 = 4 credits. Each test sets its own x-elfa-credits header (the documented per-call charge, https://docs.elfa.ai/api/v3/endpoints/list-events) to cover the claim winning over the card, dedup discounts, malformed values and provider errors. No live header recording is claimed.
